blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said the heat index peaked at 42°C in Palawan and Zamboanga del Sur on Monday, Nov. 23. Based on its five-day computed heat index, the highest were recorded in its stations located in Coron and Puerto Princesa City, Palawan and Zamboanga City.
